components.name: Royal Gold Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-royal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C6A76B 0%, #B59556 100%); color: #151210; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -2px rgba(133, 99, 38, 0.35); }

components.name: Obsidian High-Contrast Action Button
components.css: .ds-btn-obsidian { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; background-color: #221E1A; color: #FAF7F2; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(21, 18, 16, 0.22); }

components.name: Ghost Ivory Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-ivory { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #221E1A; border: 1px solid #E4D9C8; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Atelier Elevation Card
components.css: .ds-card-atelier { background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E4D9C8; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; color: #221E1A; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px -6px rgba(34, 30, 26, 0.06); }

components.name: Atelier Form Field
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input-atelier" placeholder="مثال: قاعة ليلتي الكبرى" />
components.css: .ds-input-atelier { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #E4D9C8; background-color: #FCFBF8; color: #221E1A; font-size: 0.9375rem; }

components.name: Royal Entry QR Ticket Surface
components.css: .ds-qr-ticket { max-width: 28rem; background-color: #FCFBF8; border: 1px solid rgba(198, 167, 107, 0.4); border-radius: 1.5rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-qr-ticket-head { background-color: #151210; color: #DFC99E; padding: 1.25rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; } .ds-qr-ticket-body { padding: 1.5rem; text-align: center; color: #221E1A; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; }
